sources.entry: Traggo - Traggo is a tag-based time tracking tool. In Traggo there are no tasks, only tagged time spans. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Docker/Go

summary.one_liner: Traggo is a self-hosted, tag-based time tracker where time is recorded as tagged spans rather than tasks.
summary.what_it_does: Traggo records time as spans that carry user-defined tags, such as a project tag or a type tag with values like email, programming, or meeting. Users can build their own tag scheme, and there are no separate task objects. The README describes customizable dashboards with diagrams, a list view and a calendar view of tracked time, and a web UI with multiple themes. It includes simple user management. The project says it is meant to be hosted by the user so that data stays under their control. The README does not give install commands; it only links to an Install Guide, a Configuration page, and a dev environment setup.
use_cases: track time spent on different projects
categorize work hours by type with tags
view time logs in calendar or list
how_to_run: See the Install Guide linked from the README
notable: No tasks: only tagged time spans
Calendar and list views of tracked time
caveats: Must be hosted by the user; no hosted service is described in the README
Install and configuration details are only in linked guides, not in the README
